record.where: The losable holdings (v3.39 — towns taken by force, a post that can fall, the grey banners' wars)

clauses.text: the registries; THE STORMING gated then funded
the arrival's garrison with the love gone, the relations, the season, the mail, the lesson
held ground eating six rations in two periods, the drum at the season's rate, the hottest town never the pick while garrisoned, the square's grey, RELEASE

figure.note: two periods of the tithe clock take exactly six rations, 40 → 34 on the shelf

clauses.text: THE POST STORMED and LOST against two shields with the ring reverting and the dearer retake
STAND THE POST holding at three, the walker with a back holding at two, four refused and holding by hand, the sheet's rows
the two wars with the larder biting, not biting, hushed, and the needs resolving from the live world
and the needs resolving from the live world; the save
A risen town now takes a third answer beside the quell and the parley: the column goes THROUGH the door.
Five shields, 90 metal and 30 provisions, gated on the mountain road like the taking.

figure.note: the row reads them; a real click pays exactly 90 metal and 30 provisions and five shields march

clauses.text: The arrival does not restore the light; it TAKES the town
the lamp goes back up under a GARRISON of two shields (drawn in the square under Farkeep's grey pennant, the plate reading GARRISONED — THE REPUBLIC)

figure.note: the held town stands exactly two shields (the row's garrison 2), drawn flanking the square

clauses.text: forty likes go out with the Unlit's banner

figure.note: the town's likes fall from 60 to exactly 20

clauses.text: three relations move (Farkeep↔the Unlit, the Unlit↔Waylight, the Keepers↔Waylight)

figure.note: farkeep|rebels −2, rebels|waylight −1, flamekeepers|waylight −1, the ledger naming the storming

clauses.text: the garrison EATS: three rations off the town's own shelf every two minutes, counted on the sheet

figure.note: the row reads 3 food every 120 s; two periods eat six, and the garrisoned row reads the six eaten

clauses.text: A garrisoned town cannot rise — the rebellion's pick skips it, which is what the garrison is for.
`unlitReprisal`, a second reprisal row fired by the verb — for ten minutes the Unlit's drum beats × 1.5 in every town with a lamp to douse.

figure.note: the season opens at 600 s; the pressure clock runs ×1.5 (to 0.01) with it against without

clauses.text: RELEASE THE GARRISON on the banner sheet frees the town: ten likes come back at once

figure.note: a real click on RELEASE gives back exactly ten likes

clauses.text: and the town's own choice returns with it
In the camps' season of reprisal a held watchpost is rolled once a night: three knives come for the ground.

figure.note: the row reads 3; the mail reads 3 knives against 2 shields, and against 3

clauses.text: The post HOLDS when its shields, and the walker standing the fire inside 260 units with every fed back beside them, match the knives — the mail names them.

figure.note: the row reads 260; the walker stands the fire well inside it with one fed back, and the post holds at two shields

clauses.text: It FALLS otherwise: the ring is the camps' again with its runners back, the salvage scattered, the grey pennant lying in the ring for ten minutes with the pole across it

figure.note: the row reads 600 s; the pennant and THE POST FELL stand on the ground and are gone a second after it

clauses.text: the nearest town six likes poorer, a stone likelier (0.6), the mail and a lesson

figure.record: six likes poorer, a stone likelier (0.6)
figure.note: the nearest town falls from 40 to 34; the row's stone chance reads 0.6, above the held post's

clauses.text: STAND THE POST on the sheet puts another shield at the fire (40 metal, 10 provisions) up to four

figure.note: a real click pays exactly 40 metal and 10 provisions for a third shield; at four the button is dark and the verb refused

clauses.text: the sheet shows SHIELDS n/4 and the season's warning
A post lost once costs × 1.5 to take again

figure.note: the retake's metal, wood and provisions are each the taking's ×1.5, rounded

clauses.text: the sheet prints the price and the day it fell
`larderRaid` (raiders → the Hollow Fires, by night, a larder a live camp can reach)
the fire burns LOW for seven minutes

figure.note: the row reads 420 s; the raided larder's plate reads RAIDED — BURNS LOW

clauses.text: its hunting ring halves, so the same ground that bit does not

figure.note: the ground 100 from the fire bites unraided and does not bite raided; the half radius itself is not sampled

clauses.text: and a crate of rations lands in the camp's stash it did not earn on the road
`reaperVisit` (the Reapers → the Hollow Fires, a larder in the mist): the file walks through and the eaters go to ground — the larder is HUSHED for five minutes and does not hunt at all.

figure.note: the larder is hushed for exactly 300 s and does not bite even at its fire

clauses.text: Both write the RELATIONS ledger on pairs it already held (the raiders and the eaters, the eaters and the file), both mail, both read on the banner sheet as a plate on the larder's row (RAIDED — BURNS LOW · Ns, HUSHED — THE FILE PASSED · Ns).
TWO LESSONS: the storming, the post fell (41 pages)
